comparison.objective: Seat an access panel and place two retainer bars into rib slots; candidate performs dry media screening.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar panel alignment followed by two constrained bar placements versus bimanual tool motion and orientation-dependent granular passage.
comparison.success_condition: Panel flush and both bars flat, aligned and overlapping the panel by ≥20 mm; candidate uses mass recovery, washer retention and released dwell. The simulation rubric does not distinguish a motionless still-gripped part, but this omission does not create duplication.
comparison.reason: Panel closeout is a multi-part alignment task, not material separation.
